200.description: Validation marketplace capabilities and trust boundary
Active paid validation products with payment-offer pricing metadata

post.description: Publish a validator-signed validation product. Validator must have an active uniquely controlled attestor safety profile and a matching active payment offer.

422.description: Payment offer does not match validator or validation action

post.description: Create a subject-Passport-signed validation request using one independently authorized payment order. The payment order is consumed exactly once by the request transaction.

409.description: Payment/order request is already consumed or raced

422.description: Payment parties or offer do not match the validation product

post.description: Record a validator-Passport-signed passed, failed, or inconclusive result. Passed results require a SHA-256 evidence digest. Payment never guarantees a passed outcome.

400.description: Invalid outcome or missing required evidence digest

403.description: Validator mismatch or validator is no longer safety-qualified

get.description: Return completed paid validation evidence. Non-domain subject references are exposed only as digests. No numeric trust score is produced.
